paragraphs.text: Tasha is a blue / black -aligned human witch from the Forgotten Realms , featured in Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate . Though depicted on a planeswalker card, Tasha is not a planeswalker within Magic lore.
A famous archmage and demonologist from Oerth , whose actual name is Iggwilv . She wrote the Demonomicon of Iggwilv , a tome on demonic lore.
Unlike planeswalkers in Magic lore, as a D&D character, she does not have a planeswalker's spark .
